allowed: You may call the API programmatically, including automated and agent-driven pipelines.
You may use the outputs, including for commercial purposes; OpenAI claims no ownership of outputs.
You may retain and store outputs under your own policies.
forbidden: You must not circumvent rate limits or service restrictions, or scrape the website in place of the API.
You must not use outputs to develop models that compete with OpenAI's services.
You must not misrepresent outputs as human-authored where disclosure is required.
You must not reverse engineer the services or underlying models.
retention: OpenAI states API inputs/outputs are not used for training and are retained at most around 30 days for abuse monitoring unless a longer or zero-retention arrangement applies (as of the verification date).
training: OpenAI does not train on API inputs by default.
